steps.d: Check you qualify: you held National Instruments (NATI) shares at the open of trading on August 12, 2022 and sold some of them between August 12 and September 28, 2022.

Log in to your brokerage account and download the statements or trade confirmations covering August and September 2022. You need your share balance on August 12, 2022, every NATI sale or purchase through September 28, 2022, and your balance after that.
If you can't find the records, call your broker and ask for NATI transaction history for 2022. Many brokers will also file the claim for you if you ask.
Open https://nationalinstrumentssecuritiesclassaction.com/file-a-claim/ and start a new claim.
Enter your claimant details: full legal name as it appears on the account, any joint owner, the account type, your Social Security number or tax ID, mailing address, phone and email.
Enter your opening position: the number of NATI shares you held at the open of trading on August 12, 2022.
Enter each transaction from August 12 to September 28, 2022: trade date, buy or sell, number of shares, and price per share or total amount, exactly as shown on your statement.
Enter the number of NATI shares you held at the close of trading on September 28, 2022.
Upload your brokerage statements or confirmations (PDF or photo) that show the holdings and trades you entered.
Read the certifications, then sign electronically. If the account is joint, both owners must sign.
Submit the claim before January 14, 2027 and save or screenshot the confirmation page and claim number.
Send that confirmation number to Claimclub from your dashboard so we can track your claim and payout.
